title: I built an AI trading assistant that you can talk to like Jarvis.
author: iam_warrior
selftext:
I’ve been building an AI trading assistant that allows you to get market updates and execute insights just by talking to it no need to stare at your charts all day.

It works completely hands-free, just like having your own Jarvis for the markets. Would love to hear your thoughts or what features you'd want in an AI like this!
